title: My Boss Paid Me in Exposure 🦊
description: An original animated fox comedy about the worst paycheck ever. Watch the Wi-Fi reveal and the rent-day twist. #Shorts #Animation #Comedy

segments.text: My boss said he'd pay me in exposure.
So I put his Wi-Fi password on the office wall.
He said, 'You're fired!' I said, 'Great. More exposure.'
Now I'm asking my landlord if exposure covers rent.
